## Who should enter

- Clean energy generation, storage and grid integration with operating data
- Emissions measurement, reduction and removal with a stated methodology
- Circular economy, recycling and waste innovation at industrial scale
- Climate adaptation and resilience work with communities or infrastructure
- Materials, process or chemistry work that cut energy or emissions intensity

What this award recognises is a measurable environmental result — tonnes avoided, waste diverted, energy displaced — with the method stated plainly enough to be checked.

If the innovation is a vehicle, battery or charging network, enter Innovation in EV & Automobile. If it sits in the production process, enter Innovation in Manufacturing.

Nomination registration

Register your company and category through the nomination process, then complete the detailed nomination form and processing fee.

Jury presentation

Present the innovation to the jury and take questions. Jurors score each entry against the four evaluation criteria and rank it within its category.

...
Finalists announced

- Quantum, photonics and advanced computing work with reproducible results
- Advanced materials, sensors and biometrics moving from lab to product
- Space systems, launch, satellite and in-orbit servicing technology
- Defence and dual-use engineering with a validation pathway
- Research spin-outs where the intellectual property and the physics are the moat

What this award recognises is a hard technical claim you can defend — data, peer review, a test campaign, a customer who put it in the field. Ambition alone is not evidence.

- The application form must be filled in English.

results.title: Programs - Edge AI and Vision Product of the Year Award - Edge AI and Vision Alliance
results.snippet:
The Product of the Year Award program is open exclusively for our Alliance Member companies and recognizes the innovation and achievement of building-block technologies. All of these categories cover the full range of edge AI applications and technologies – not limited to just vision. For example, in the camera and sensor product category, any type of sensor data is eligible: images, audio, vibration, radar, lidar and the like. Entries are evaluated by a panel of independent industry experts awarding top honors to one company in each category.
...
- Open exclusively for Alliance Member companies
- Seven categories for enabling technologies: processors, processor IP, software and algorithms, vision language models, cameras and sensors, computers and boards and development platforms
- Covers the full range of edge AI applications and technologies—not just vision
- Winning entries are chosen by an independent panel of judges
- Deadline for submissions: January 17, 2025
- Awards ceremony at the 2025 Embedded Vision Summit, May 20-22, 2025
...
- To be eligible, your new product (or update to your existing product with the innovation described in your entry) must have been first delivered to your customer between January 1, 2024 and December 31, 2024. If your product is delivered in the form of intellectual property (IP), then your IP must have been first delivered to your customer between January 1, 2023 and December 31, 2024. We have intentionally made the first delivery date flexible to include delivering samples or providing early access to your external customers. Your product does not have to be in full production, but it must have a publicly available description of features and technical specifications for our judges to evaluate.

journey.assessment: The four searches returned the right page type (award nomination pages) and mostly the right market (India), but the coverage is skewed toward circular-economy/recycling bodies (CII 4R, RECEIC, EEF, APIC) and generic AI/deep-tech programmes (ET AI Awards, AGBA, Nasscom Emerge 50/National Startup Awards, Edge AI and Vision Alliance). Two problems stand out. First, almost everything surfaced is an award; no ranking or honours list (growth/fast-company, sustainability league table) has appeared, even though this run explicitly seeks rankings. Second, the profile's most defensible differentiated impact — 12,000+ informal waste workers digitally onboarded with transparent payments, 37.5% income increase, 110+ livelihoods at Kedarnath, an all-women on-ground team — is not addressed by any result: nothing covers social impact and inclusive-innovation recognition for a private company in India. EPR and traceability recognition is also untouched, and several results are past editions or bodies whose Indian eligibility is unverified. The single most valuable gap to close is an Indian social-impact/livelihoods award cycle for the 2027 edition.

results.snippet:
NEW DELHI (India CSR®): Organisations and corporate social responsibility leaders working to deliver measurable and sustainable social impact across India have been invited to submit nominations for the SETU Bandhan CSR Awards 2026. The awards ceremony will be held on August 21, 2026, at Juniper Hall, India Habitat Centre, New Delhi, from 10:30 am to 4 pm. Instituted under SETU, the flagship thought leadership forum of Bandhan Konnagar, the national recognition platform seeks to celebrate organisations and leaders contributing to inclusive development through responsible business practices.
...
includes self-help groups, entrepreneurship, farmer ... enterprise sustainability. ... healthcare, maternal and child health, ... health and nutrition
...
## Eligibility Requirements

Registered companies, corporate foundations, Section 8 companies, trusts and societies may participate, provided their nominated CSR programme has been implemented in India. Applicants must have completed at least one financial year. Projects executed or implemented during FY 2025–26 and/or FY 2026–27 will be eligible for consideration. The initiatives must comply with Schedule VII of the Companies Act, 2013. An organisation may submit one application in each category, subject to a maximum of three submissions. Supporting documents are mandatory, while an independent third-party assessment is preferred.
...
## How to Nominate

Interested organisations can download the nomination form from bandhan.org/setu-2026. The completed application, along with the required supporting documents, must be submitted by email to setu@bandhan.org 

Nomination deadline: Open.

Eligible organisations should, therefore, complete and submit their applications at the earliest opportunity ahead of the awards programme on August 21, 2026.

results.title: About Us
results.snippet:
Ministry of Corporate Affairs, Government of India has instituted National Corporate Responsibility (CSR) Awards to recognize companies that have made a positive impact on the society through their innovative & sustainable CSR initiatives. This award is the apex recognition of CSR initiatives in India. First National CSR Awards ceremony was organized on 29 October 2019 with Hon'ble President of India as the Chief Guest. The second cycle of Awards - 2020 is also near completion.
...
Category I - Corporate Awards for Excellence in CSR

Companies Having Eligible CSR Spend Equal And Above Rs. 100 Crores;

Companies Having Eligible CSR Spend Equal And Above Rs. 10 Crores And Less Than Rs. 100 Crores;

Companies Having Eligible CSR Spend Equal And Above Rs.1 Crore And Less Than Rs.10 Crores; And

Companies Having Eligible CSR Spend Below Rs. 1 Crore
...
All the companies registered under the Companies Act 2013 and complying with provisions of Section 135 of the Act are eligible for nomination. In order to refer the Financial Year of CSR expenditure and duration of the CSR projects / programmes to be considered for specific award cycle, please read the updated Scheme of National CSR Awards.

How to apply

Applications to NCSRA can be made by the companies through seeking nomination by a designated nominating organization. Nominating Organizations, after due diligence of applications may submit the Nominations online on www.csr.gov.in as per format of Nomination given in the Scheme document.

Categories of Nominating Organizations

The following category of organizations can nominate the projects of the companies for consideration of NCSRA: - Ministries / Departments of Govt. of India; - State Governments and Union Territories (UTs); - Professional Institutions: ICSI, ICAI,ICMAI; and - National Level Trade and Industry Bodies/Chambers: CII, FICCI, ASSOCHAM, PHDCCI, SIDBI, FISME, SCOPE, Laghu Udyog Bharti, Indian Merchants Chamber, Bombay Chamber of Commerce and Industry, Indian Chamber of Commerce, and India SME Forum.

Last date for submission of nomination for the National CSR Awards has been extended till 31 August, 2022.
